v: Ha in Pablo in tik, ay in och t'a preso, yujto swak'och in pensar t'a Cristo Jesús. Ha in yet' winh kuk'tak Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko karta tik t'ayach ach Filemón. Te xajan ach kuuj, yujto ketb'eyum ko b'a t'a smunlajel Dios.
Tzak' stzatzil sk'ool heb' kreyente smolb'ej sb'a t'a a pat. Tzak'pax stzatzil sk'ool ix kanab' Apia yet' winh kuk'tak Arquipo, yujto syak'pax wal yip winh t'a yik Dios ket'ok.
Aokab' ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo syak' swach'k'olal yet' sjunk'olal t'ayex ta'.
Ayik tzin lesalwi, swak' wal yuj diosal t'a Dios uuj,
yujto swab' t'a tik to tzak' wal och Kajal Jesús t'a a k'ool. Swab'i to te xajan Kajalil chi' uuj, tza xajanej pax masanil heb' yikxo Dios.
Ay heb' syak'och Cristo t'a sk'ool uuj, yujto ix ak'och t'a a k'ool. Tzin k'an t'a Dios, yik ol wach' nachajel yuj heb' to a Cristo Jesús tz'ak'an masanil tas wach' t'ayonh.
Tzin te tzalaj wal uuj ach wuk'tak, yujto tza xajanej heb' ta'. Uuj sjawi sniwanil in k'ool t'a tik, yujto tzak' wal stzalajk'olal heb' kreyente ta'.
Yujto tza xajanej heb' yikxo Dios chi', yuj chi' ijan tzin tek'b'ej in b'a ach in chekan yuj tas yowalil tza k'ulej ta'.

Palta mantok tzach wak' mandar. Tonhej tzin k'an t'ayach yik ol cheklajelok to sko xajanej ko b'a. Ha in Pablo in tik, icham winak in xo. Ha tiknaik, ayinto och t'a preso, yujto swak'och in pensar t'a Cristo Jesús.
Tzin k'an wal t'ayach yuj winhaj Onésimo, yujto icha wuninal ix aj winh t'a yol preso tik, yujto ix scha Cristo winh wuuj.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo ayik ix ach yak'an serwil winh, malaj jab'ok yopisio winh t'ayach. Haxo tiknaik, te ay yopisio winh t'ayach yet' pax t'ayin.
Yuj chi', tik tzin chekb'at winh t'ayach. Tza cha winh sk'ochi, icha tzutej a chaan in k'ochi.
In gana ix aj winh wet' t'a tik, yik tzin yak' serwil winh, yik ichato a ach tzul in ak' serwil t'a yol preso tik. Ay in och t'a preso yujnhej to swalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.
Palta malaj in gana tzin b'ab'laj b'oej in trato yet' winh masanto tzin k'anb'ej wab' t'ayach. Yujto in gana, to tz'el wal t'a a k'ool tzak' pawor t'ayin yet' winh, manh ak'b'ilok pural tzach wutej.
Yel toni, ix el winh elelal t'ayach jaye' k'ual. Palta icham chi' ix aji yik tz'ajxi winh t'ayach t'a junelnhej.

Ha tiknaik manhxo chekab'oknhej yaj winh t'ayach. Másxo niwan yopisio winh, yujto kuk'takxo winh. Te xajanab'il winh wuuj. Ha achxo, másxo wal tza xajanej winh ayik ol k'ochxok winh t'ayach. Manh yujok to a chekab' winh tza xajanej winh, palta yujto yikxo Kajalil yaj winh ket'ok.
Yuj chi', tato tza na wet'ok to ketb'eyum ko b'a, tza cha winh sk'och ta' ichato a in tzin k'ochi.
Tato ay sb'ok winh t'ayach, ma ay junokxo smul winh ix ochi, tzak'kan t'a in kuenta.
Ha in Pablo in tik ol wak' sb'ok winh chi' t'ayach, yuj chi' swak' in ti', tzin tz'ib'anpaxb'at t'ayach yet' in k'ab'. Palta ojtak paxi, ichato ay a b'ok t'ayin, yujto wuuj ix a cha Cristo.
Yuj chi' wuk'tak, ak' pawor t'ayin t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús. Ak' in tzalajk'olal yuj Cristo.
Swalb'at juntzanh tik t'ayach, yujto tza k'anab'ajej wal. Wojtak to manhoknhej tas swalb'at tik t'ayach ol a k'ulej, palta ol ek' t'a yib'anh a k'ulan juntzanhxo tas.
Swalpaxb'at junxo tik t'ayach to tzak' lista jab'ok in posado ta'. Talaj icha chi' ol el t'a sk'ool Dios, ol in yak'b'at t'ayex ta', icha tz'aj he k'anan t'a he lesal.
Ha winh kuk'tak Epafras tik, syak'b'at stzatzil a k'ool winh. Ayto ochta winh t'a preso tik wet'ok, yujto syak'paxoch spensar winh t'a Cristo Jesús.
Haxo heb' smunlaj wet' t'a tik, haton winhaj Marcos, winhaj Aristarco, winhaj Demas yet' winhaj Lucas, syak'paxb'at stzatzil a k'ool heb' winh.
Aokab' Kajal Jesucristo syak' swach'k'olal t'ayex ta'.
